# lab models

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

```text
Download every model listed in setup/models-<machine>.txt into /srv/models, then check each sha256.
  lab models                 this machine's list
  lab models zaphod gemma    only lines whose destination contains "gemma"
Safe to re-run: finished files are skipped (still checked), partial ones resume. Pinned revisions: same bytes
every time. Takes hours for a full machine: run it inside tmux.
Good result: "have"/"checking" per file, then MODELS-OK (exit 0). MODELS-FAILED exits 1.
```

Usage:

```
lab models [machine] [filter]
```
